description: A signed URL to send one of the user's files to this server, for files on their machine that the server can't read: PUT the file there (curl --fail -T interview.mp4 '<url>'), then media.import {source: {upload_id}}. The URL needs no other credentials and works for a day. A broken upload resumes: HEAD the url for Upload-Offset (the bytes received), then PUT the rest with Content-Range: bytes <offset>-<last>/<total>. Large files can go in parts the same way. Without a way to send it yourself, give the user the url: opened in a browser it is a page to drop the file on, which sends it and resumes on its own. media.import says whether the file is all in yet.

bytes.description: The file size, to be refused now rather than part way if it is too big

name.description: The file name with its extension, e.g. interview.mp4

name: media.upload

url.description: Signed: PUT the file here; no other credentials needed

title: Upload media
